composition.serve_who: Sheet 2 of BAE drawing 1905D023 serves the two starboard BEL devices, BEL1-S and BEL2-S: the left and right sheet regions are explicitly headed BEL1-S and BEL2-S and give each device’s I/O pin map, synchronization/return wiring, chain signals, and shielded CAN-A connection. The sheet is therefore a device-loop membership/interconnection view, while the repeated CAN-A and synchronization/chain cabling belongs to the shared BEL-system wiring infrastructure rather than to either converter’s power-conversion function.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The complete left-hand circuit is explicitly labelled BEL1-S, matching the dedicated BEL1 starboard register node; all G3-S3… signals and the upper BEL/RTN1, SYNC, and CAN-A connector continuations in that region attach to this device.

functions.label: Set BEL1-S operating configuration
functions.what_it_does: Provides BEL1-S with its frequency-selection and address/enable configuration inputs; the drawing shows FREQ_SELECT referenced to the device return, while ENABLE, ADR_0, and ADR_1 are intentionally not connected at their shown far ends.

flow_scenarios.path: BEL1-S pin 7 VBATTERY RTN (G3-S3R1) → drawn strap to BEL1-S pin 2 FREQ_SELECT (G3-S3S1); BEL1-S pin 1 ENABLE (G3-S329), pin 8 ADR_0 (G3-S300a), and pin 9 ADR_1 (G3-S300b) → shown N/C ends, so no external command path exists on this sheet
No external enable or address command scenario is drawn; the ENABLE, ADR_0, and ADR_1 conductors terminate N/C and must not be extended by inference

key_components: enable input at pin 1, shown N/C
address inputs at pins 8 and 9, shown N/C

facts: BEL1-S is connected by G3-S3AH CANA_HI and G3-S3AL CANA_LO as a shielded twisted differential pair.
G3-S3AS CANA_Shield is drawn separately from HI and LO.
The segment continues only to the upper-left CAN-A connector block on this sheet; no line joins it to the BEL2-S CAN-A segment and no neighbour or bus terminator is identified.
The upper-left SYNC block is a two-wire continuation with terminals 10 and 3 and a twisted-pair route to BEL1-S synchronization/return wiring.
G3-S3R1 SYNC RTN is tied into BEL1-S VBATTERY RTN and the BEL/RTN1 continuation.
G3-S321 CHAIN_OUTPUT and G3-S3S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY are exposed at BEL1-S, but their ultimate source/next device is not shown.
BEL2-S is connected by G3-S4AH CANA_HI and G3-S4AL CANA_LO as a shielded twisted differential pair.
G3-S4AS CANA_Shield is drawn separately from HI and LO.
The segment continues only to the upper-right CAN-A connector block on this sheet; no line joins it to the BEL1-S CAN-A segment and no neighbour or bus terminator is identified.
The upper-right SYNC block is a two-wire continuation with terminals 9 and 4 and a twisted-pair route to BEL2-S synchronization/return wiring.
G3-S4R1 SYNC_RTN is tied into BEL2-S VBATTERY RTN and the BEL/RTN1 continuation.
G3-S421 CHAIN_OUTPUT and G3-S4S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY are exposed at BEL2-S, but their ultimate source/next device is not shown.
